# KI: Trusted Gateway Control Plane & Deterministic Sandboxed Execution

## Operational Summary
Connecting external chat channels (Telegram, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp) directly to agent tool executors exposes the host system to arbitrary code execution via untrusted inbound messages. Establishing a unified JSON-RPC WebSocket Gateway with pairing codes, session placement policies, and deterministic execution approval gates enforces a strict boundary between untrusted ingress and sandboxed tool runtimes.
